lines: Manish Sharma, Promoter Selling Shareholder, may receive up to ₹6.08 crore from selling up to 45,000 shares in the offer for sale.
The trigger is old: proceeds have been in hand since 11 Mar 2026, 248 days ago, so this is not a recent event.
Their retained stake is an estimate of ₹110.73 crore, valued at the offer price of ₹1,352 per share.
Proceeds are up to ₹6.08 crore; employee-portion shares sell at a discount, so actual proceeds are slightly lower. Gain is unknown.
